newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU, Russia to negotiate fishing accord.
newsitem.headline: EU, Russia to negotiate fishing accord.

text.p: Fisheries Commissioner Emma Bonino and Russian Fisheries Minister Vladimir Sosno have agreed to negotiate a fishing agreement but set no starting date, a Commission official said on Wednesday.
"They agreed the need for an agreement but it was only a very general discussion," an official said.
During the meeting on Tuesday, Bonino and Sosno discussed the commercial aspects of a future agreement and management of joint stocks in the Baltic.

They also agreed that bilateral agreements between the former Soviet Union and Sweden and Finland should be transposed to take account of the collapse of the USSR and Sweden and Finland's membership of the EU.
